programs.title: I Was Prey: Invisible Assassin
programs.desc: Diver Tim Saxon films underwater at the Great Barrier Reef and gets stung by an Irukandji jellyfish, one of the world's most venomous animals  a grizzly bear attacks forester George Knoll in the remote Great Bear Rainforest.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Crocodile Love Story
programs.desc: It's moving day for Acco, the zoo's biggest crocodile  all goes to plan until his mate Cassie goes into hiding  the team races to reunite the bonded pair in their new enclosure  the rescue unit fights to save a flying fox entangled in barbed wire.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Repeat Offender
programs.desc: Tigger, a repeat offender, has done it again and Shaun must battle high winds this time to get him down  Tom comes face to face with a friendly Fritter, who turns hostile on a dime.

programs.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Sold Into Slavery
programs.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees that are being sold on the black market.

programs.title: Shark Week's 50 Best Bites
programs.desc: A countdown of the 50 greatest Shark Week moments of all time during Shark Week's 30th anniversary celebration, with Craig Ferguson, Tracy Morgan, Andy Samberg, and others.

programs.title: My Cat From Hell
programs.desc: A mother and daughter are being torn apart by their cat Missy, who seems determined to kill their other cat Fluffy  a tortie named Candy beats up a 9-year-old because she isn't so sweet.
